User: “Explain quantum entanglement in two sentences for a curious 12-year-old.”

Quantum entanglement is when two tiny particles become linked so that whatever happens to one instantly affects the other, even if they’re very far apart. It’s like they share a secret connection that no one fully understands yet, but we can still use it to make super-secure messages and powerful new technologies.
